column3: BootUI checks recorder.hasWrappedDataSource() after SqlTraceDataSourceBeanPostProcessor wraps a Spring DataSource bean; Python has no container DataSource beans, so sharpit treats the SQL source as wrapped once SQLAlchemy statement listeners are attached (or sqlite3 is traced, or an engine is registered on an attached context) and returns "No DataSource has been wrapped for tracing yet." otherwise

Pool connect/checkout/checkin listeners publish ConnectionPayload on checkin with dataSource, waitNanos, statements and obtainedNanos; executed statements pay no per-statement cost; deriving the count at check-in adds about 3.6 µs per released connection (paired sbx measurement, within the 40 µs budget), growing with the statements on the connection; -1 remains only when rows were evicted or unrecorded during a paused checkout

BootUI calls SqlTraceRecorder.registerDataSource only after DataSource proxy wrapping succeeds; sharpit rolls back sqla.add on listener attach failure and requires attached (or explicitly suspended) statement listeners before a registered engine counts as a recorded SQLAlchemy source
